texts.Volunteers_HealthCheck_RollupsOffDetail: These volunteer totals are inactive, so the fields they fill stop updating and the reports, list views and dashboard that use them go stale: {1}. If you turned them off on purpose, nothing is wrong. Otherwise open Rollup Builder, set each one Active, then choose Recalculate.

texts.Volunteers_Hours_ApprovedNotDeletable: Approved hours count in totals, so they cannot be deleted. Reopen them first (move them back to Submitted, which needs the Manage Volunteers permission), then delete them.
